title: JANUS Engine — dedicated research-branch manifest
purpose: Structured index for JANUS Engine architecture, simulations, literature crawls and staged validation without prematurely merging research conclusions into main.

architecture_modes.MODE_A_DIRECT_GILL_PEMFC: water -> POMS gill -> low-pO2 recirculating cathode gas -> PEMFC -> bidirectional DC bus -> auxiliaries + battery
architecture_modes.MODE_B_INTEGRATED_VRU_AKS: dissolved-gas extraction -> conditioning -> O2/N2 separation -> useful O2/N2 duties -> optional cryogenic branch

latest_findings.magnetic_selection: Coreless/slotless axial-flux PM starter-generator selected as first Axle magnetic architecture. It directly solves startup, controlled rotation and regeneration without intentionally creating a magnetic braking barrier that later needs cancellation.
latest_findings.active_cancellation: Position-synchronous current injection remains an optional ripple/cogging-trim function only if bench data shows enough benefit to exceed coil/inverter losses.
latest_findings.electropermanent_role: Electropermanent/variable-flux magnets are retained for infrequent persistent state changes such as latches, valves or rare flux modes, not baseline per-pole Axle commutation.
latest_findings.battery_integration: Externally precharged battery supplies startup and transients. After PEMFC/gill stabilization, genuine surplus can recharge the same battery; self-drive remains battery-neutral only if SOC is non-decreasing with external charger disconnected.
latest_findings.scale_management: Low-hardness water + low-adhesion wall + Axle/wipers + crystal trap remain the layered calcium-control architecture.

current_project_state.dominant_boss: Bench-measure Axle breakaway/drag torque, starter energy, motor/generator efficiency, inverter idle loss and eddy-current interaction, then feed measured values into the POMS/PEMFC startup model.

next_actions: Parameterize/build a coreless AFPM bench article and measure no-current breakaway/drag torque versus RPM.
Map motor and generator efficiency at 60/120/300/600 RPM and measure inverter idle/switching load.
Integrate measured startup electrical energy into battery sizing and RUN-005 transient state machine.
Test harmonic torque-ripple compensation only if native ripple justifies its electrical cost.
Reserve electropermanent magnets for low-duty-cycle persistent states rather than per-revolution Axle switching.
